mutations.name: FILM-2006 U1 the cut count is the shot count
mutations.find: const cutCount = shotCount === null ? null : shotCount - 1;
mutations.pattern: derives cut count, shot length, cut density, hook and AI share from the report

mutations.name: FILM-2006 U2 no operations reads as a 0% AI share
mutations.pattern: no operations at all is an unknown AI share

mutations.name: FILM-2006 U3 a hand cut-density band survives beside the measured one
mutations.pattern: a measured cut density replaces a hand-recorded band

mutations.name: FILM-2006 U4 an unrecorded figure becomes the lowest band
mutations.replace:
if (value === null) return bands[0]!.slug;
  if (!Number.isFinite(value) || value < 0) return null;
mutations.pattern: a figure not recorded gives no attribute

mutations.name: FILM-2006 U5 the genome ignores edit style
mutations.pattern: adds edit style as an optional dimension

mutations.name: FILM-2006 U6 the TARGET_CHANGED alert counts every error
mutations.pattern: raises nothing when no render expired

mutations.name: FILM-2006 DB1 any signed-in user reads a session's device
mutations.sql: create or replace function public.edit_session_device(p_session_id uuid) returns text language sql stable security definer set search_path = '' as $$ select c.name from public.edit_sessions s join public.mcp_connections c on c.id = s.connection_id where s.id = p_session_id $$;

mutations.name: FILM-2006 DB2 the delivery panel answers a team owner
mutations.sql: create or replace function public.admin_studio_delivery_stats(p_days integer default 7) returns table (get_edit_package_calls bigint, deliver_edit_calls bigint, target_changed_refusals bigint, uploading_over_24h bigint, expired_uploads bigint) language plpgsql stable security definer set search_path = '' as $$ begin return query select 0::bigint, 0::bigint, 0::bigint, 0::bigint, 0::bigint; end; $$;
